key_claims.claim: Pooled meta-analysis of 26 studies quantifies interobserver and intraobserver variability for UA, MCA, and uterine artery Doppler, revealing heterogeneous reproducibility across indices
Prospective comparison shows ultrasound and MRI have comparable diagnostic accuracy for deep endometriosis compartments when mapped to Enzian classification
Lung growth trajectories after FETO differ between right- and left-sided CDH, with occlusion duration influencing observed-to-expected lung-to-head ratio changes
A bilateral multisite UA Doppler scoring system correlates with composite adverse perinatal outcomes in a prospective FGR cohort
Machine learning models using third-trimester biometry and Doppler modestly outperform logistic regression for predicting LGA neonates with adverse outcomes
